credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of O'Keeffe sitting on her portale at Ghost Ranch looking out towards what she calls " My front Yard" which is the view of the Pedernal. She is flanked by organic shaped wooden shelves displaying her collections of bones and stones, a rams skull and a bandana; a large cow skull hangs on the adobe wall with rows of vigas visible.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe on Ghost Ranch Portal
